query: MATCH (c:Compound {name: 'Warfarin'}), (d:Disease {name: "Alzheimer's disease"}) MATCH p = allShortestPaths((c)-[*..4]-(d)) RETURN length(p) AS hops, [n IN nodes(p) | n.name] AS path, [r IN relationships(p) | type(r)] AS types ORDER BY path
